Mariner Wealth Advisors Holding in Gilead Sciences (GILD) Has Cut as Shares Rose; Clal Insurance Enterprises Holdings LTD Has Raised Holding in Verint Sys Com (VRNT) as Share Value Declined
May 13, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Clal Insurance Enterprises Holdings Ltd increased its stake in Verint Sys Inc Com (VRNT) by 31.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clal Insurance Enterprises Holdings Ltd bought 107,488 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 447,677 shares of the edp services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.74M, up from 340,189 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clal Insurance Enterprises Holdings Ltd who had been investing in Verint Sys Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.68 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.76% or $0.75 during the last trading session, reaching $41.9. About 158,544 shares traded. Verint Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:VRNT) has declined 5.87% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.42% the S&P500.
